description: This file contains a set of shell script tests designed to verify the behavior of Git commands, particularly focusing on diffing, object fetching, and negotiation behavior in partial clone scenarios. It uses a testing framework with functions like test_expect_success, test_create_repo, and test_config to set up repositories, configure Git, and check outputs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of the provided commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository at the specified location.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified repository, optionally with specific content.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in input, used for validation.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a specific file path is missing, used to confirm cleanup.
